name: luna-pool-orchestrator
description: Token-first or worktree-isolated speed-first engineering orchestration with bounded Luna workers, a shared operations leader, and token-free native status.

interface.shortDescription: Low-cost Luna work with visible Sol governance.
interface.longDescription: Heliolune offers persistent token-first Luna/max lanes and Sol-defined four/eight-worker speed bursts behind a start-once, await-once MCP boundary. Parallel writes use detached Git worktrees and deterministic safe-apply gates. One shared Luna/high operations leader manages long-running sessions and compresses results while Sol retains planning, architecture, risk, integration review, and final acceptance. A native Windows panel shows token-free live status.
defaultPrompt: Use $luna-pool-orchestrator in token-first mode for one bounded engineering task.
Use $luna-pool-orchestrator in four-way speed-first mode for independent workstreams.
